scripts.build:preview: npm run compile:contract && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('./dist',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc && vite build --mode preview && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/donor-proof/keys','./dist/keys',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/donor-proof/zkir','./dist/zkir',{recursive:true});"
